title: Onboard Voyager-14B v1.0: metadata, perf profiles, and changelog automation
author: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Motivation: onboard Voyager-14B v1.0 into the model registry with full metadata, performance profiles, and automated changelog/release-notes wiring. Voyager is a community-contributed LLM that our infra team validated for compatibility with Redwood runtime. This PR bundles the metadata, curated perf profiles derived from our perf-lab runs, and a small automation hook so that changelog entries are produced during model publish flows.

What this PR does: - Adds canonical metadata.yaml for voyager-14b v1.0 (license, authors, tokenizer, model-architecture notes, recommended quantization knobs). - Adds performance profiles (latency/throughput envelopes) and a short summary of the benchmarking methodology used to generate them. Profiles include p95 latency at 128/512 tokens on A100-80GB and T4 testbeds, and throughput numbers for batch sizes 1, 4, 8. - Adds a lightweight changelog generation script (tools/changelog/generate_release_notes.py) which reads model metadata and perf profiles and emits a templated release note entry. This is wired into the model publish CI job. - Updates registry index and docs page (docs/models/voyager.md) with usage examples and supported variants.

Checklist: - [x] metadata schema validated (tools/validate_metadata.py) - [x] perf profiles generated from perf-lab runs and reviewed by infra team - [x] changelog automation hooked into model-publish pipeline (ci/model-publish.yaml) - [x] unit and integration tests added for metadata validation and changelog generation - [x] docs page updated with example config and known limitations

Notes on perf methodology: perf artifacts were generated using perf-canary harness in benchmark-lab; runs are reproducible via scripts in tests/benchmarks/voyager. We include the raw run ids and a summarized CSV in models/voyager-14b/v1.0/perf_runs.csv. The perf numbers are conservative (we selected median stable runs after 3 re-runs) and include commentary on which quantization profiles were used.

Backward compatibility: metadata changes are additive and non-breaking. The changelog automation is opt-in and triggered only for releases that include a changelog entry flag in the publish manifest.

Related Linear: ENG-1842 (model onboarding), PM-873 (release planning). Related support ticket SUP-4521 captured a pre-onboarding data residency question that was resolved prior to publish.

Testing and validation: unit tests (tests/models/test_metadata_validation.py) exercised the metadata schema and negative cases. Perf validation tests (tests/models/test_voyager_perf.py) assert shapes/thresholds. CI passes full model-publish flow in the feature branch before merge.

Link to internal benchmark artifacts and raw logs: internal link omitted in public PR body. For infra reviewers: see perf run ids in models/voyager-14b/v1.0/perf_runs.csv for exact test artifacts.

merge_commit_message: Onboard voyager-14b v1.0: add metadata, perf profiles, changelog automation (squashed)
release_notes:
- Onboarded Voyager-14B v1.0: added canonical metadata, curated performance profiles, and automated changelog generation for model publish.
- Performance profiles include p50/p95/p99 latency and throughput benchmarks for A100-80GB and T4; see models/voyager-14b/v1.0/perf_profiles.json for details.
- Changelog automation will generate a templated release note during model publish; maintainers should review and edit before final release.
notes: This PR was coordinated with infra and docs teams. No customer-facing breaking changes. Follow-up work: add longer-run stress profiles and include additional hardware configs (V100/RTX) in a separate PR.
